Lina (People Ops): Sharing a tiny 'goal framing + quick feedback' kit for managers and ICs. 3 quick templates (30s read) + suggested 1:1 scripts. :sparkles:

Marcus (Eng Manager): Nice! Can you drop a couple of examples? I'm prepping 1:1s next week.

Lina (People Ops): Sure. High-level pattern: "Outcome (what we want) — Signal (how we measure it) — 2 quick actions". Examples:
- Outcome: Reduce inference latency by 15% — Signal: p50 latency for /generate <= 180ms for 90% of requests — Actions: tune batching config, add KV cache for hot prefixes
- Outcome: Improve cross-team onboarding NPS to 8+ — Signal: onboarding survey avg >= 8 — Actions: ship onboarding checklist, host two office hours

Anya (Product IC): Love the format. For self-reviews — do we want people to include context (traffic shift, infra work) with the signals?

Lina (People Ops): Yes — ask ICs to add a 1-sentence context line. Eg: "Context: handled 3 infra incidents, traffic +20%". Keeps reviewers from mis-attributing.

Marcus (Eng Manager): Handy. Any suggested one-liners for manager feedback in calibration? I get stuck between vague praise and actionable notes.

Lina (People Ops): Try these short frames:
- "Observed: <specific behavior>. Impact: <what changed>. Next step: <concrete ask>."
- Example: "Observed: reduced token cost by 12% via quant config. Impact: lower infra spend and faster p95. Next step: share changelog + perf playbook with infra team." 

PeopleOpsBot: Link to canonical doc: https://intranet.redwood/jobs/goal-framing-kit (internal) :link:

Anya (Product IC): Also, any micro-templates for self-review bullets? TL;DR versions that fit in forms.

Lina (People Ops): Yep — give ICs 3-line max per goal: 1) Outcome + metric, 2) Context (1 sentence), 3) One sentence reflection or next step. Example: "Increase embeddings recall by 6% — metric: rerank recall @10 +6% — Context: updated training set, A/B test on reranker — Reflection: need to run extended eval on long-tail queries." :memo:

Marcus (Eng Manager): Awesome, I'll paste these into my 1:1 agenda. Thanks Lina :thumbsup:

Lina (People Ops): Happy to iterate — ping me if you want a manager cheat sheet tailored to infra teams. :eyes:
